text:
Maya G.: Postmortem follow-up for Atlas dedicated incident. Short: on-prem BGP instability + our isolation controller misinterpreting transient withdrawals -> broad tenant isolation (~4h). Need owners, ETAs, and recurrence detection.

Maya G.: Proposed actions:
• Peering policy tweaks (hold-time, dampening) — owner/ETA?
• Isolation controller patch (debounce + prefix origin checks) — owner/ETA?
• Canary harness for on-prem peering (synthetic /24 + tenant) — owner/ETA?
• Runbook updates + staging smoke tests — owner/ETA?
• Alerting: route-flap -> auto ticket + pager — owner/ETA?

Theo R.: I can take peering policy. Plan: per-peer dampening, keepalive adjust only for Atlas neighbors, verify in staging. ETA: plan & PR in 9 days, staged rollout 16 days.

Vik S.: I'll own the isolation controller changes. Patch plan: 20s debounce for withdraws, require same origin-AS and a prefix-length guard, emit a metric for isolation decisions. ETA: hotfix in 3 business days, canary 8 days.

rdw-bot: Jira created RDW-2500 (atlas-peering-policy), RDW-2501 (isolation-controller-patch), RDW-2502 (onprem-canary-harness). Links: https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2500 , https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2501 , https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2502

Tanya (oncall): I'll build the canary harness and smoke script. Suggest using a non-prod /24 and synthetic traffic for 30m post-change. ETA: harness in 5 days.

Luis C.: I'll update the runbook and add pre/post checks (BGP neighbor health, route count delta). Also will add a checklist to require customer BGP logs during validation. Runbook ETA: 2 days.

Theo R.: Preflight check snippet for staging:
```
# BGP neighbor summary on staging-router
ssh ops@staging-router 'vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"'
```

Vik S.: Local sim for route churn in test env:
```
# simulate transient withdraws
for i in 1 2 3; do ip route add 198.51.100.0/24 via 192.0.2.$i; sleep 15; ip route del 198.51.100.0/24; done
```

Tanya (oncall): Alert proposal: alert if >3 BGP resets for a peer in 10m OR >6 route changes for atlas-prefixes in 15m -> auto-open RDW incident and tag atlas. I'll wire auto-ticketing.

Maya G.: Prioritization: RDW-2501 (controller patch) = prio:critical, RDW-2500 = prio:high, RDW-2502 = prio:medium. Hotfix must land before any mass rollback.

rdw-bot: Calendar invite "Atlas peering remediation sync" scheduled at 2244003600. Invitees: @Theo R., @Vik S., @Tanya (oncall), @Luis C., @Maya G.

Theo R.: small note: avoid lowering hold-time across backbone; prefer targeted dampening per-customer neighbor.

Vik S.: Agreed — debounce + origin checks first.

Maya G.: Please confirm owners & ETAs here by EOD. If blockers, call out now.

Theo R.: confirmed owner RDW-2500, ETA plan in 9 days.
Vik S.: confirmed owner RDW-2501, ETA hotfix 3 business days.
Tanya (oncall): confirmed RDW-2502, ETA 5 days for harness.
Luis C.: runbook updated in 2 days, will post link to RDW-2502.

Maya G.: Thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem and add a monthly peering stability check for Atlas. If anything changes, reply and I'll sync with PM/CSM. :white_check_mark:
